The documents don't cover the 2011 season, so they can't answer this directly.

The 2010 Monaco Grand Prix was won by Mark Webber of Red Bull [1]. The retrieved documents only cover Monaco 2009, 2010, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025, plus the 2010 Korean and European Grands Prix, so none of them give Red Bull's 2011 results.

From general knowledge rather than the documents, Red Bull won 12 races in 2011, so that is my best answer, but it is unverified against the provided material.

ANSWER: 12
